searchText: peak performance has been achieved internally finally consistently fast on all cases, including beacon state + beacon block decoding has gone down from 129 µs to 56 µs there was a few pesky allocations being done all over the place, which i patched now now i can *finally* take a break had a weird thing going on, where i had unnecessary bottlenecks that only really showed up on big cases like beacon state. beacon block decoding could’ve been faster the whole time but i didn’t really notice at first cause it was already way faster. benchmarking sure is tricky great work 🔥
